# Kalpa exam kits

One-payment, no-expiry exam planners, trackers and date alerts by Kalpa Labs (Hyderabad).

- [TGPSC Group 2 kit](https://kits.kalpalabs.dpdns.org/tgpsc-group2/)
- [TGPSC Group 3 kit](https://kits.kalpalabs.dpdns.org/tgpsc-group3/)
- [GATE 2027 CS kit](https://kits.kalpalabs.dpdns.org/gate-2027-cs/)
- [RRB NTPC kit](https://kits.kalpalabs.dpdns.org/rrb-ntpc/)
- [SSC CGL kit](https://kits.kalpalabs.dpdns.org/ssc-cgl/)
